excerpt.zh: 这是一片古战场。在此处，古老的帝国们为了争夺星海的至上霸权相互碾轧。现在，帝国已然是过往云烟，只剩下这些挂着旗帜的战舰残骸。
excerpt.en: A long-forgotten battlefield where ancient empires once fought for supremacy of the galaxy - now all that remains are the vessels of those who fought under their banners.

texts.zh: 我们派遣了一批[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]去分析调查[From.solar_system.GetName]中古老战舰的遗骸，从其中收集一切我们能得到的东西。我们虽然没能确定这些战舰作战的确切年代，也不知道它们究竟所属何方，但还是获得了一些关于这些舰船的建造技术。
texts.en: We sent in some of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] to analyze the remains of the ancient battleships in [From.solar_system.GetName], and glean from them what they can. Though unable to determine how old these vessels are, or for what banner they once fought, they managed to derive some information about the building techniques used to craft the ships.

# 古战场 / Ancient Battlefield

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 5级异常，只由三个“独特星系”初始化器（unique_system_initializer_04/05/06）放置。  
  Level-5 anomaly placed only by three unique-system initializers (04/05/06).

  unique.125 "Ancient Battlefield": studying the ancient wrecks gives 25% progress toward the next regular ship technology.
